items.title: PSG ‘make Rodri transfer enquiry as Champions League winners look to beat Real Madrid for Man City star’

items.title: England Netball prepare for Australia by thrashing Northern Ireland in Glasgow
items.summary: England thrashed Northern Ireland 83-34 on the opening day of the Netball pool stage at the Commonwealth Games but Scotland were beaten by New Zealand.
